services.name: Fishing Reports
services.desc: July fishing can very hot but very rewarding. You can expect great red fishing especially in the early mornings and late afternoons, live bait and top waters have been a few key baits to get the job done. The snook bite continues to stay really strong on the hard incoming tides on the outside points using live bait and fast moving weedless jerkbaits. The grouper bite is staying steady especially for the heat of summer the summer time storms have been keeping the water temperatures down. Anywhere from 15-30 you can expect to catch quality grouper on live and dead baits. blurb: Being a native of Citrus County, I grew up fishing the backcountry and grass flats of Crystal River and Homosassa. For as long as I can remember all I ever wanted to do was fish. As a young boy my passion on the water slowly grew into a career. In 2016 I started my own charter business called Crystal River Fishing Company.
